display.title: Episode 6: The Strange Visitor
display.summary_short: Children drum along on pot covers for the first Hakochainik march, and hear how an orphan who studied Torah alone in a forest cave found a holy teacher and grew up to be the Baal Shem Tov.
display.summary_long: A listener writes that her family marched around the table while she drummed on a pot cover with a big spoon, so Uncle Yossi has everyone (with Mommy's permission) practice the beat and march along, and mentions the word "Hakochainik" for the first time. Story time is "The Strange Visitor". Little Yisroelik was orphaned at five, and never forgot his father's last words: fear nothing and no one, only Hashem. He found an empty cave in the woods and secretly went there every day to daven and learn. One day an old man with a white beard and sparkling eyes found him and asked if he was afraid to be alone; Yisroelik answered that he was never alone, because Hashem was with him. The stranger became his teacher, and the boy grew up to be the Baal Shem Tov. A young studio guest says that nearly 70,000 children have joined Tzivos Hashem, and in the first mailbox "splashdown", a girl asks to come and lead the Shema on the air.
display.lesson: Be afraid of nothing but Hashem; with Hashem we are never alone.
